git_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل github.com/settings/tokens
2) اضغط 'Generate new token (classic)'
3) اختر صلاحية 'repo' كاملة
4) انسخ التوكن (يبدأ بـ ghp_)
git_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit github.com/settings/tokens
2) Click 'Generate new token (classic)'
3) Select 'repo' scope
4) Copy the token (starts with ghp_)

git_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens
2) اعطه اسم + اختر صلاحية 'read_repository, write_repository'
3) اضغط 'Create personal access token'
4) انسخ التوكن
git_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens
2) Name it + select 'read_repository, write_repository'
3) Click 'Create personal access token'
4) Copy the token

git_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل bitbucket.org/account/settings/app-passwords/
2) اضغط 'Create app password'
3) اختر صلاحيات 'Repositories: Read + Write'
4) انسخ الباسورد فوراً (ما يظهر مرة ثانية)
git_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit bitbucket.org/account/settings/app-passwords/
2) Click 'Create app password'
3) Select 'Repositories: Read + Write'
4) Copy immediately (won't show again)

git_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل dev.azure.com → User Settings → Personal Access Tokens
2) اضغط 'New Token' مع صلاحية Code (Full)
3) انسخ التوكن
git_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit dev.azure.com → User Settings → Personal Access Tokens
2) Click 'New Token' with Code (Full) scope
3) Copy the token

git_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل user/settings/applications على سيرفر Gitea
2) Generate New Token مع صلاحية write:repository
3) انسخ التوكن + شارك URL السيرفر
git_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit user/settings/applications on your Gitea server
2) Generate New Token with write:repository scope
3) Copy token + share server URL

git_providers.instructions_ar: شارك رابط المستودع — الذكاء يدرسه ويقترح طريقة الوصول الصحيحة.
git_providers.instructions_en: Share your repo URL — the AI will research it and suggest the right access method.

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل vercel.com/account/tokens
2) Create Token → اعطه اسم + Scope = Full Account
3) انسخ التوكن
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit vercel.com/account/tokens
2) Create Token → name it + Scope = Full Account
3) Copy the token

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل app.netlify.com/user/applications
2) New access token → انسخ التوكن
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit app.netlify.com/user/applications
2) New access token → copy it

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
2) Create Token → استخدم template 'Edit Cloudflare Workers'
3) انسخ التوكن + Account ID من overview
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
2) Create Token → use 'Edit Cloudflare Workers' template
3) Copy token + Account ID from overview

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) من Hetzner Cloud Console → Servers → اختر السيرفر → ستجد IP
2) المستخدم عادة 'root'
3) شارك Private SSH Key اللي أضفته عند الإنشاء
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) From Hetzner Cloud Console → Servers → pick server → find IP
2) User usually 'root'
3) Share the Private SSH Key you added at creation

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ادخل cloud.digitalocean.com/droplets → اختر droplet
2) انسخ IPv4 + المستخدم 'root'
3) Private key اللي اخترته وقت الإنشاء
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Visit cloud.digitalocean.com/droplets → pick droplet
2) Copy IPv4 + user 'root'
3) Private key chosen at creation time

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) AWS Console → EC2 → اختر Instance → Public IPv4 + User (ubuntu/ec2-user)
2) شارك .pem file اللي حمّلته وقت الإنشاء
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) AWS Console → EC2 → pick Instance → Public IPv4 + User (ubuntu/ec2-user)
2) Share the .pem file downloaded at creation

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) Hostinger Panel → Files → FTP Accounts
2) أنشئ حساب FTP جديد + احفظ Host/User/Password
3) Port عادة 21 (FTP) أو 22 (SFTP)
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Hostinger Panel → Files → FTP Accounts
2) Create new FTP account + save Host/User/Password
3) Port usually 21 (FTP) or 22 (SFTP)

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) GoDaddy → My Products → Hosting → cPanel Admin
2) FTP Accounts → أنشئ حساب أو استخدم الموجود
3) Host: ftp.yourdomain.com
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) GoDaddy → My Products → Hosting → cPanel Admin
2) FTP Accounts → create or use existing
3) Host: ftp.yourdomain.com

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) Bluehost → Advanced → cPanel
2) Security → Manage API Tokens → Create
3) انسخ التوكن + URL الـ cPanel
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Bluehost → Advanced → cPanel
2) Security → Manage API Tokens → Create
3) Copy token + cPanel URL

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) WP Admin → Users → Profile
2) انزل لـ 'Application Passwords'
3) New Application Password → انسخ كلمة السر
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) WP Admin → Users → Profile
2) Scroll to 'Application Passwords'
3) New Application Password → copy

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) dashboard.render.com → Account Settings → API Keys
2) Create API Key → انسخه
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) dashboard.render.com → Account Settings → API Keys
2) Create API Key → copy

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) railway.app → Account Settings → Tokens
2) Create Token → انسخه
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) railway.app → Account Settings → Tokens
2) Create Token → copy

hosting_providers.instructions_ar:
1) ثبّت Firebase CLI: npm i -g firebase-tools
2) شغّل: firebase login:ci
3) انسخ التوكن + Project ID من console.firebase.google.com
hosting_providers.instructions_en:
1) Install Firebase CLI: npm i -g firebase-tools
2) Run: firebase login:ci
3) Copy token + Project ID from console.firebase.google.com

hosting_providers.instructions_ar: شارك اسم/رابط الاستضافة — الذكاء يدرسها ويقترح أنسب طريقة وصول.
hosting_providers.instructions_en: Share the hosting name/URL — the AI will research it and propose the best access path.
